jobs.title: Jr. Document Controller
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Document Controller for our office in Sacramento, California. This position will support the development, management and maintenance of program documents and records throughout the project lifecycle, helping ensure information is accurate, traceable, secure and readily accessible to project teams and stakeholders.

The Document Controller will help administer the program’s Document Control System (DCS), maintain document standards and workflows, support version control and records management, and promote consistent document control practices across contracts and project teams. The role will work closely with state personnel, consultants, contractors and internal teams to support timely document submission, review, approval, distribution and retrieval.

This position will also support document control procedures, training, audits and reporting while helping maintain compliance with contractual, regulatory and quality management requirements.

Key responsibilities

• Establish and maintain document control systems, workflows and procedures for document submission, review, approval, distribution, retention and retrieval.
• Support the setup and configuration of the Document Control System (DCS), including folder structures, metadata requirements, naming conventions, workflows, user roles and permissions.
• Receive, review and log documents from contractors, consultants and internal teams, ensuring required metadata and document information are accurate and complete.
• Maintain master project records, document revisions and version control while ensuring compliance with established formatting, numbering and naming conventions.
• Coordinate with contractors, consultants and internal stakeholders to support timely document submissions, reviews, approvals and retrieval.
• Maintain and update the Document Control Management Guide (DCMG), procedures, templates and reference materials to reflect current program requirements and system changes.
• Monitor document status, review turnaround times and workflow bottlenecks, and prepare dashboards, trackers and reports for project leadership.
• Perform periodic document and system audits to identify missing records, metadata issues, overdue reviews, unauthorized revisions or approval gaps and support corrective actions.
• Support document archiving, retention requirements, project closeout, audits, handovers, legal holds and public records requests as applicable.
• Assist with the development and implementation of standardized document control policies, procedures, templates and tools across contracts and project teams.
• Provide onboarding, training and ongoing user support for document control processes and systems, including maintaining training materials and records.
• Support compliance with applicable quality management, contractual, legal and regulatory requirements, including ISO 9001:2015 and relevant Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) and Federal Transit Administration (FTA) requirements.
• Support internal and external audits related to document traceability, version control, records management and document control procedures.
• Evaluate document control processes and recommend practical improvements that strengthen consistency, efficiency and system effectiveness.
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with project staff, state personnel, consultants, contractors and other program stakeholders.

Minimum requirements

• BA/BS plus 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience providing document control or records management support for large infrastructure, transportation, construction or capital improvement programs.
• Experience administering or supporting an electronic document management system or Document Control System (DCS).
• Experience managing document workflows, metadata, revision control, document numbering, transmittals, approvals and records retention requirements.
• Experience working with contractors, consultants, government agencies or multidisciplinary project teams in a program or project delivery environment.
• Knowledge of document control quality assurance and quality control practices and audit requirements.
• Familiarity with ISO 9001:2015 quality management requirements and document control practices associated with federally funded transportation programs.
• Experience developing document control procedures, user guides, training materials, dashboards or document status reports.
• Strong organizational, communication and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple document workflows and priorities accurately.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and document management, collaboration or project information management platforms.

• Sponsorship is not offered for this position.

jobs.title: Early Literacy Instructional Lead
jobs.description:
The Early Literacy Lead is an exciting opportunity for an individual with deep content knowledge of literacy at the primary school level (PreK through 2nd Grade) and passion for curriculum and instruction. The Early Literacy Lead will play a critical role at the state-level in one of KIPP’s most progressive reform efforts in order to drive improved student results, including growth and achievement, college and career readiness, and closing the achievement gap.

The Early Literacy Lead is responsible for leading the strategy and implementation of state literacy priorities, including building teacher and API content knowledge in foundational literacy through leading Reading Academies learning in order to improve and accelerate student achievement across PreK-2 classrooms.  This role can require travel to all four KIPP Texas regions (Austin, Dallas/Ft. Worth, Houston & San Antonio), and about 75% of time will be spent in schools and classrooms.

• Implementing the KIPP Texas Early Literacy Strategy | Execute KTX multi-year PreK-3rd grade early literacy initiatives through strategic, region-specific support across the state including but not limited to the Texas Reading Academies.
• Reading Academies Cohort Lead | Lead Reading Academies Module learning and facilitate coaching cycle with learning in alignment with School Leader development of Literacy Instruction and Achievement..
• Coaching | Coach and support PreK instructional leaders, Reading Academies participants, including but not limited to Assistant Principals of Instruction (APIs) and teachers to grow and achieve goals literacy as aligned to our statewide implementation plan.
• Data Analysis | Analyze data at student-level, teacher-level, school-level and regional-level to identify strengths, opportunities for growth aligned to the Science of Teaching Reading, and curricular and implementation implications

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage success of Reading Academies implementation for assigned cohorts
• Lead implementation of state literacy priorities, including but not limited to reading growth assessment/s, foundational literacy across the state for grades PreK-3.
• Develop, manage, and lead literacy pilots across the state to innovate and try new programs, structures, and strategies; gather implementation data and artifacts on a weekly basis to make statewide programmatic recommendations for future years.
• Serve as a model of the three instructional coaching power moves – intellectual preparation, instructional coaching, and data-driven instruction. Coach regional Early Literacy leads, APs, SLs, and regional academics teams members across the state in the power moves when coaching in schools.
• Conduct Texas statewide and region-specific data analysis to guide regions around intentional data driven response in instruction.
• Work with the Director of Foundational Literacy and Instructional Excellence team to maintain strong curriculum and implementation feedback cycles, vertical alignment and streamlined literacy support across all grades.
• Support KTX regions in developing their literacy-specific professional learning scope & sequence and professional learning plans.
• Plan and lead virtual and in-person literacy professional development for Reading Academies participants K-3 including lesson internalization, module internalization, and responding to data.

QUALIFICATIONS:

*Texas Reading Academies Cohort Leader screener required to complete the responsibilities of this role.  Proof of passing the Texas Reading Academies Cohort Leader screener will be required prior to starting employment. For more information about completing the Reading Academies Cohort Leader Screener click here.

COMPETENCY AND SKILLS:

Content and Pedagogical Expertise

• Strong knowledge and believe in the college-ready bar for students in literacy; exceptionally high standards for rigor and the belief that all students can achieve at high levels
• Expert in literacy in the early primary grades (Pre-K through 3rd Grade) with a strong knowledge of the full literacy continuum (Pre-K through 12th Grade)
• Strong knowledge of the components of balanced literacy, with a particular focus on Foundational Literacy (phonemic awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary and comprehension)
• Strong background and familiarity with literacy assessments, with a particular focus on reading growth assessments
• Master teacher in literacy with strong skill in internalizing curriculum and modeling lessons
• Strong coach of teachers with expertise in observation and feedback
• (Preferred) Strong coach of leaders with the ability to model strong coaching and school leadership

Technical Skills

• Detail oriented and obsessed with accuracy, especially in the areas of curriculum and assessments
• Ability to create own work plan and can project plan around multiple priorities and fast-paced deadlines
• Able to succinctly present summaries and updates
• Can work across multiple modes of communication (virtual and in-person) to impact others and achieve goals
• Advanced understanding of Microsoft Office suite

Communication, Interpersonal and Team Skills

• Builds and maintains strong relationships across a variety of levels and stakeholders
• Strong verbal and written communication skills; tailors message for the audience, context, and mode of communication
• Motivates others to work in partnership toward ambitious goals
• Builds consensus and resolves conflicts; exhibits willingness to have difficult conversations
• Skillfully navigates systems and structures at various levels in a large district
• Comfortable in ambiguity and can take abstract ideas into concrete work plans and products

Problem Solving and Systems Level Thinking

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik Kcentar Sub City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse-Nuclear Medicine, Full-time Days
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications
• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations
• Use of a keyboard to enter or retrieve data

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Nursing specialty certification, if eligible

Second & Third Shift Available

• Maintain and improve the performance and precision of robotic and automated systems
• Diagnose issues with sensors, actuators, servo drives, and control systems
• Operate machine shop equipment such as lathes, grinders, and welding tools as needed
• Utilize diagnostic tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.) to identify and resolve equipment issues
• Support and implement PLC programming updates and system improvements
• Read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical documentation to support repairs and installations

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment in compliance with safety standards

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moving equipment and industrial conditions
• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and perform repetitive movements such as bending, twisting, and lifting
• Ability to lift up to 45 pounds independently and move heavier items with assistance or lifting equipment
• Occasional work at heights and use of ladders

Required Qualifications

• Associate degree in Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, Electrical Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Experience troubleshooting and repairing electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems in a manufacturing environment
• Working knowledge of PLC programming (Ladder Logic, STL, or similar)
• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, blueprints, and technical manuals
• Experience with servo systems, robotics, and automated equipment
• Familiarity with industrial electrical systems, including AC/DC circuits, motor wiring, and control wiring
• Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement solutions
• Experience using diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other testing equipment
• Strong mechanical aptitude and experience with preventative maintenance programs
• Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and manage multiple priorities

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Siemens PLC systems (Step 7, TIA Portal, or similar platforms)
• Experience working with servo-hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems
• Familiarity with robotic systems and precision alignment processes

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



As a Clinical Operations Specialist, you'll be crucial to upholding the quality of information in our systems. 



WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, we're on a mission to simplify and accelerate access to diagnostic imaging for patients and clinicians. As a Clinical Operations Specialist, you'll be crucial to upholding the quality of information in our systems. Your primary responsibility will be to cross-reference key patient and customer data to ensure our systems are correct. You will also be expected to respond to clients on an ongoing basis.



You’ll report directly to one of our key team members, who has significant experience building out our reports and client service functions.



We're seeking a resourceful, proactive, detail-oriented, and hard-working individual who shares our passion for revolutionizing the diagnostic imaging industry.



Some of the types of things you could be getting involved in are:

 - Ensuring diagnostic imaging and reports match the scheduled appointments in our database and records

 - Focusing on the quality of our information and ensuring 100% accuracy in the information we send out

 - Working with other departments within the company, managing requests, and giving clear, concise written updates

 - Updating our clients on the status of their patient records (primarily via email, but could be phone occasionally)

 - Communicating via email with our Radiology groups to complete tasks such as elevating priority on a report to a STAT or answering questions they may have related to appointment details.

 - Basic troubleshooting and triaging of technical issues to route to the appropriate team for resolution.

 - Responding ad hoc to key client inquiries.

 - Working with sensitive data and understanding the requirements of HIPAA
   
   

THE TOP 3 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE

 1. Be the ‘safe pair of hands’ within our team, such that all your work is accurate and the quality of our data is high

 2. Be a trusted #2 to your manager so that you are capable of completing every task asked of you

 3. Attend professional development opportunities for personal and business growth
    
    

WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE:

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value and that everyone should want to learn. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - Strong knowledge of medical imaging procedures and workflow.

 - Team player is front and center as each of us plays our part in the study management cycle.

 - Attention to detail and a maniacal focus on ensuring information is correct.

 - A commitment to hard work and bringing a positive outlook to work every day.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with clients

 - Knowledge of radiology workflows and basic technical concepts

 - Resilience and a willingness to continuously improve by taking critical feedback from your manager and teammates.

 - Ability to comfortably navigate within MS Excel (ability to create Pivot Tables and/or conduct VLOOKUPs is a huge plus)




AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done because of it.

 - Tier 3 — For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-Aware. You lead with subject matter expertise, but you're comfortable using AI for things like admin, documentation, or research so you can spend more time with patients—and you know where AI stops and human judgment has to take over. (clinical, hands-on, and highly regulated roles where hands-on expertise is the core value)
   
   - Your craft comes first; AI supports it. You're curious, not resistant, and open to tools that cut admin so you spend more time on patients.
   
   - You can hold a sensible conversation about where AI helps your function and where human judgment is non-negotiable.
   
   - Assessment: a short conversation on how you see AI fitting your work. No technical test.

One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.

 


A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. For you to be successful at Scan.com http://Scan.com you must embody our values.



 


OUR VALUES

Always Play Offense

If we're not growing, we're dying. Everyone needs a bias for action. Speed and momentum, combined with quality execution, propel our business forward.

 - You don't quit on hard problems. Fail fast, dust off, go again.

 - You celebrate wins, then seek the next opportunity.

 - You see it, you fix it. No task is beneath you, at any level.

Build with the Best

The company we build is the team we build. If we don't have the right people in the right seats, doing the right things, we will fail.

 - Talent recognizes talent. You actively bring quality hires into the business.

 - You trust your colleagues to deliver.

 - You open-source your knowledge. You're never a single point of failure.

Care Deeply, Challenge Directly

Care enough to have the hard conversations, and don't dwell on them. Don't go up the chain to communicate. Go straight to the person.

 - Strong opinions, weakly held. You welcome challenge and feedback.

 - You get to the point: direct challenge plus an alternative solution.

 - You ask "why". Before calling something bad, understand why it exists.

Embrace Growth, Be Curious

Push the limits of your understanding and potential, and you will be supported to get better.

 - You proactively seek feedback, whatever your level.

 - You invest in understanding our business: teams, customers, processes.

 - You invest in your own growth and are willing to unlearn.

We're a high-performing team with low ego. We hire people who are brilliant and kind, who give it straight, back it up with evidence, and change their mind when the facts change. We'll give you real ownership early, the tools to do your best work, and colleagues who raise your game. In return, we ask for high standards, genuine care for patients and each other, and the drive to leave things better than you found them. If that sounds like you, let’s talk!

 

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU:

We strive to keep our interview process brief and aim to move through the stages efficiently. Due to availability, there may be a change to the order of the interview process, but generally speaking, this is what you can expect:

 - Introductory call/interview with our Senior Talent Partner. The call is typically made via telephone and lasts approximately 30 minutes.

 - If there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 - All of our roles will have a small assessment stage. This may be an in-person assessment, a take-home assessment, or additional video calls. The length varies, but we’re mindful of your time and strive to keep it as simple as possible.

 - Offer!




WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $45,000 - $55,000

 - 401k

 - Healthcare, Vision, and Dental

 - All the equipment needed for you to do your role effectively

 - Flexible working (3 days in office, 2 remote)

 - Personal Development budgets

 - 18 days PTO plus public holidays

 - 10 paid sick days

 - Inclusive policies designed by our team, for our team




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

NetBox Labs is hiring a People Operations Manager to run the day to day operations behind a globally distributed team. We are 135 people across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, and Spain, and we are growing. Every hire, change, and exit means a contract, a payroll entry, a benefits enrollment, a system record, and a compliance obligation under that country's rules. This role owns that work, mostly in Justworks and Deel.



Most of our headcount is in the US, so that is where the transaction volume sits. Our international population is smaller and considerably more complex, with different filing requirements and employment rules in each country. International work is a meaningful share of this job, not an occasional task.



You also get to build. A single system of record. People data clean enough that Finance and the board plan against it. The infrastructure behind our leveling and compensation framework. Automation that retires the manual cycles. You will work directly with the Head of People, alongside Finance and Legal, with the access to make decisions rather than route them. Payroll, compliance, and employee support come first, and project work happens around a floor that never slips.




WHO THIS IS FOR

This role is for someone who takes real pride in the craft of operations. You are fast and precise inside an HR system and you trust the record you leave behind. You notice when two systems disagree and you want to know why.  You also spot the problem behind the ticket.



When something breaks twice you come back with a fix and a recommendation instead of a flag. Hand you a messy, half-defined project and you turn it into a plan. You already use AI in your own work and you would rather teach a tool to handle the repetitive part than build a better spreadsheet.

Much of this work is detailed, and it matters most when nobody has to think about it. This role is focused on making the operational foundation solid, with real latitude in how you get there.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Employee lifecycle operations

 - Own new hire setup end to end in Justworks, including onboarding records, payroll and tax setup, benefits enrollment, and systems access

 - Own exits end to end, including termination processing, final pay, benefits continuation, equity coordination with Finance, and access removal

 - Process every employee change, including comp, title, level, manager, location, and employment status, with clean documentation behind each one

 - Manage employment documentation, contracts, amendments, and letters across our US and international entities

 - Serve as first line support for employee questions on pay, benefits, leave, time off, and policy

 - Maintain and improve the people operations knowledge base and process documentation



International employment and compliance

 - Own the people compliance calendar across every country we operate in, including filings, registrations, statutory deadlines, and annual returns

 - Run the operational relationship with our EOR partners, including hires, changes, exits, invoicing, and issue resolution

 - Track country specific employment requirements, including statutory leave, notice, probation, and termination rules, and escalate to Legal where judgment is needed

 - Support new country openings end to end from the operational side, working with our EOR and legal partners

 - Serve as the operational point of contact for our EMEA and APAC employees

 - Keep employee records accurate, complete, and audit ready across every entity



Payroll and benefits administration

 - Run payroll across all entities and platforms, including calendar management, review, reconciliation, and accuracy

 - Administer US and international benefits day to day, including enrollments, changes, terminations, invoicing, and vendor coordination

 - Execute open enrollment, from setup and communications through employee support and audit

 - Administer leaves of absence in coordination with our PEO, EOR, and Legal



Systems and data

 - Own data integrity in our HR system of record, including audits, permissions, workflows, and integrations

 - Execute our consolidation onto a single global system of record, partnering with the Head of People on sequencing

 - Build and maintain recurring people reporting, including headcount, attrition, and org data used by Finance and leadership

 - Maintain the level, band, and job architecture data behind our leveling and compensation framework, so the numbers leadership plans against hold up

 - Automate manual work. If a process runs on a spreadsheet and a calendar reminder, redesign it with the tools available, AI included

 - Use AI in the operational work you own, including drafting documentation and letters, summarizing country policy differences, auditing records against source systems, and first-pass reporting

 - Bring what works back to the People team as prompts, templates, and short walkthroughs, so the whole team gets faster


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years in people operations, ideally in a high growth software company under 500 people

 - Direct, hands on experience running people operations for a multi country workforce. UK and US required. Canada, EU, or APAC a strong plus

 - Hands on payroll and benefits administration experienceExperience administering a PEO or HRIS platform as the system of record. Justworks is a strong plus

 - Fluency with spreadsheets and HR data

 - Working fluency with AI tools in day to day operational work, with specific examples of what you automated or made faster

 - Follow through –things you own do not fall through, and you close the loop without being asked

 - Excellent judgment with confidential information

 - Clear, direct written communication


NICE TO HAVE

 - Total rewards exposure such as comp cycle admin or benefits renewal support

 - Experience with an HRIS migration or consolidation

 - Familiarity with Deel, Culture Amp, Carta, or Ashby

 - Working knowledge of international employment mechanics, including EOR models, statutory entitlements, and country level filing obligations
   
   


OUR STACK

 - Justworks, US PEO

 - Justworks International and Deel, international employment

 - Culture Amp, performance management

 - Carta, equity

 - Ashby, recruiting

 - Notion and Slack, everything else


ABOUT NETBOX LABS:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.




OUR CULTURE AND VALUES: 

 - We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

 - Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

 - We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

 - Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.



NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Salesforce Support Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

Infillion is the first fully composable advertising platform, built to solve the complexity, waste, and opacity in the digital media ecosystem of the last decade. Born from $750 million in investment and the unification of category-defining technologies, including MediaMath, TrueX, Gimbal, Drawbridge, and most recently Catalina, Infillion engineered these powerful assets into scores of interchangeable, agentic-ready components.

Infillion provides a single, flexible infrastructure that serves media buyers, tech decision-makers, and media sellers. Whether through white-glove managed service, self-service control, or API-based automation, Infillion empowers businesses to execute their unique strategies with zero-hop efficiency, proprietary AI logic, and radical data transparency. Headquartered in New York City, with employees located globally in the US, Costa Rica, and Europe, Infillion powers the world's leading brands, agencies, and platforms. Learn more at www.infillion.com.

About the Job

Infillion is looking for an experienced Salesforce Support Manager to lead the Salesforce Support team and drive the effective delivery, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions across the organization.

This is a senior, highly collaborative role responsible for managing Salesforce employees and external vendors while partnering closely with business stakeholders, particularly Sales and business leadership, to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, effective Salesforce solutions.

The role combines people leadership, Salesforce expertise, project management, strategic consulting, and business partnership. The Salesforce Support Manager will be responsible for empowering and developing the team, overseeing multiple Salesforce projects, managing stakeholder relationships, supporting system releases, and ensuring solutions are delivered in accordance with Infillion, Catalina, and Salesforce best practices.

The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically capable leader who can operate independently, manage multiple priorities, assess risks, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and act as a trusted advisor to both business and technology stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead and manage the Salesforce Support team, including employees and external vendors, responsible for developing, supporting, and delivering Salesforce solutions.

• Empower team members to take ownership and accountability for projects, solutions, and business outcomes.

• Conduct regular team and project meetings to provide direction, maintain alignment, address challenges, and remove impediments.

• Ensure Salesforce solutions and deliverables adhere to Infillion, Catalina, and Salesforce best practices, design principles, and standards.

• Foster a positive, highly collaborative environment where ideas are encouraged, developed, and openly discussed.

• Provide ongoing mentoring, coaching, and guidance to team members to support successful project outcomes and individual career development.

• Create an environment focused on motivation, accountability, recognition, celebration, and professional development.

• Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly performance reviews, manage MBOs, provide constructive feedback, and support individual professional development plans.

• Continuously evaluate team performance, identify development opportunities, coach for growth and improvement, and recognize individual and team successes.

Project Management & Delivery

• Lead the assessment, planning, coordination, and delivery of Salesforce projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

• Define project goals, objectives, tasks, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria.

• Communicate project timelines, costs, objectives, risks, and status to stakeholders, clients, and senior management.

• Analyze business and client data to evaluate business health and identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and increased Salesforce adoption.

• Develop project metrics and reporting requirements to establish clear paths to success and demonstrate business value.

• Facilitate or co-lead regular status meetings with project teams, sponsors, business stakeholders, and external partners.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for the business and operational aspects of Salesforce projects.

• Coordinate communications and act as the first point of contact for the Salesforce Americas environment.

• Support team members in delivering client presentations throughout requirements gathering, solution design, pilot, and user acceptance testing phases.

• Review project deliverables prepared by team members before they are shared with clients and stakeholders.

• Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while achieving established company utilization and delivery targets.

Support, Release Management & Accountability

• Coordinate overall project success through effective collaboration with internal teams, external partners, and vendors.

• Facilitate testing activities and ensure appropriate planning and coordination of system releases.

• Ensure projects remain aligned with agreed requirements, timelines, quality standards, and business objectives.

• Identify project risks, dependencies, impediments, and resource requirements and proactively develop mitigation strategies.

• Champion documentation and training initiatives associated with Salesforce system changes, enhancements, and releases.

• Ensure appropriate knowledge transfer and user readiness for new Salesforce functionality and processes.

• Provide effective support and escalation management for Salesforce-related issues and business requests.

Strategic Consulting & Business Partnership

• Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders and business stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor on Salesforce capabilities, opportunities, and best practices.

• Continuously gather, evaluate, and act upon stakeholder feedback to strengthen relationships and improve Salesforce solutions.

• Partner cross-functionally to ensure business requirements are represented in the development of new solutions, technologies, and capabilities.

• Participate in Salesforce solution discovery sessions with technical and functional teams to identify the right solution for each business need.

• Provide strategic guidance on Salesforce capabilities, process optimization, automation, and technology opportunities.

• Develop metrics and business measures for projects to establish clear paths to success and demonstrate business value.

• Act as the primary day-to-day business and operational contact for assigned Salesforce projects.

• Identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness through automation, process redesign, and enhanced use of Salesforce capabilities.

Salesforce Expertise & Continuous Learning

• Maintain a strong understanding of Salesforce capabilities, features, enhancements, and industry best practices.

• Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases, Trailhead, Salesforce learning accelerators, certifications, Superbadges, and relevant external market developments.

• Maintain a high-level strategic understanding of Salesforce capabilities, system requirements, and evolving business needs.

jobs.title: Preconstruction Coordinator
jobs.description:
Forgen is dedicated to building a better future - for generations.

Location: Centennial, CO

Position Summary

The Preconstruction Coordinator provides administrative, technical, and field engineering support to Forgen's preconstruction and operations teams. This position assists with the preparation of estimates, quantity takeoffs, proposal documents, project capture activities, and preconstruction-to-operations turnover. Working closely with Estimators, Project Managers, Engineers, and Capture Teams, the Preconstruction Coordinator helps ensure bids, proposals, and project startup activities are accurate, organized, and aligned with company standards.

The role combines responsibilities in estimating support, field engineering, CAD drafting, quantity takeoffs, and proposal development while providing exposure to the full project lifecycle from opportunity identification through project execution.

Forgen Overview

Forgen is a leading geotechnical and specialty civil construction company operating across North America. We are dedicated to delivering innovative solutions for complex civil, geotechnical, and environmental challenges, guided by our core values: We Do What We Say, We Are Passionate About Our Work, We Are One Team, We Work Smart, and We Do The Right Thing.

Key Responsibilities

Preconstruction & Capture Support

• Support capture teams in the development and preparation of bids, proposals, presentations, and prequalification packages.

• Assist in gathering project information, bid documents, drawings, specifications, and solicitation requirements.

• Support opportunity tracking, bid calendars, and proposal schedules.

• Participate in pre-bid meetings, site visits, and client outreach activities as assigned.

• Assist in preparing technical proposal content, graphics, exhibits, schedules, and work plans.

• Help identify risks, opportunities, and competitive advantages during pursuit planning activities.

• Coordinate bid deliverables and ensure submission packages are complete and compliant.

Estimating Support

• Perform quantity takeoffs from plans, specifications, and digital models.

• Assist estimators with the development of labor, equipment, material, and subcontractor pricing.

• Obtain supplier and subcontractor quotations.

• Maintain estimating files, bid tabs, and historical cost databases.

• Support estimate reviews and bid-day activities.

• Assist in developing preliminary budgets and conceptual estimates.

• Organize and archive bid files and support documentation.

• Support schedule development using project scheduling software.

Field Engineering Support

• Review construction plans, specifications, and contract documents for constructability and completeness.

• Support technical reviews, site documentation, and project startup planning.

• Assist with project submittals, RFIs, and turnover documentation.

• Coordinate engineering, surveying, and field information during project mobilization.

• Assist Project Managers and Project Engineers with project planning and cost tracking activities.

• Support material procurement and equipment planning efforts.

• Help develop construction work packages and startup documentation for awarded projects.

Preconstruction Turnover Support

• Prepare turnover packages for operations teams upon project award.

• Organize estimate files, assumptions, risk registers, schedules, quotations, subcontractor information, and proposal commitments.

• Participate in turnover meetings with estimating, engineering, and construction teams.

• Document key bid assumptions, risks, and commercial requirements.

• Assist with project startup and mobilization planning activities.

• Ensure continuity from proposal development through project execution.

CAD & Technical Support

• Develop and revise drawings, exhibits, haul routes, staging plans, and proposal graphics.

• Generate quantity takeoffs using design drawings and digital terrain models.

• Create grading plans, sections, profiles, and site layouts.

• Support volume calculations and earthwork modeling activities.

• Assist with preparation of technical exhibits and client presentation materials.

• Maintain drawing standards and project file organization.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, Surveying, Drafting, or related field.

• 0-3 years of experience supporting construction, estimating, engineering, surveying, CAD, or preconstruction activities.

• Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, and construction documents.

• Strong organizational and communication skills are important.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Valid driver's license and ability to drive for company business.

Required Technical Skills

*Must-Have Technical Skills - AutoCAD Civil 3D | Agtek

• Microsoft Excel

• Microsoft Office Suite

• Digital quantity takeoff software

• Construction document review and interpretation

Preferred Qualifications

• Internship or experience in heavy civil, geotechnical, environmental, mining, earthwork, or specialty construction.

• Experience performing quantity takeoffs and volume calculations.

• Exposure to proposal development or construction estimating.

• Experience with Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project.

• Familiarity with surveying equipment, GPS systems, or Trimble Business Center.

• Experience supporting project engineering or field operations.

Core Competencies

• Technical aptitude and willingness to learn estimating and construction operations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and teamwork.

• Time management and organizational skills are important.

• Customer-focused mindset.

• Initiative and continuous improvement orientation.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced bid environment while maintaining accuracy.

Career Path

This role is designed as a feeder position into estimating, project engineering, or preconstruction management. Potential successor roles include Estimator I, Project Engineer II, and Preconstruction Manager.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This office and field hybrid role requires frequent computer use and effective communication, with travel to project sites as needed. Site visits may involve extended periods of standing or walking and required PPE, with potential exposure to heavy equipment, chemicals, dust, fumes, uneven terrain, and extreme weather.

This job description outlines the scope of work and is not exhaustive. Employees may be assigned extra duties as needed. Requirements may be adjusted to accommodate disabilities, except where they pose a direct safety risk.

Perks and Benefits

Forgen offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement plans, bonuses, paid time off, and more. We support a flexible work model for most non-craft positions and provide additional benefits like education assistance, wellness programs, and employee awards.

Pay Range

$75,000—$85,000 USD

Equal Opportunity

Forgen is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any legally protected status.

Privacy Policy

At Forgen, we are committed to protecting your privacy. We collect and use your personal data to manage the recruitment process, including assessing your application, verifying information, and, if applicable, entering into an employment contract. Your information may be shared with authorized third parties who perform services on our behalf, such as background checks, and only where permitted by law. We implement appropriate security measures to safeguard your information and retain it only as long as necessary for recruitment and legal purposes.

You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, and to withdraw your consent at any time where applicable. For questions or to exercise your rights, please contact hr@forgen.com.

jobs.title: Commercial Associate (SDR)
jobs.description:
COMMERCIAL ASSOCIATE (SDR)


NEW YORK



Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.



The Role

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams.

This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline.

This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention.

What you’ll do

 - Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders.

 - Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets.

 - Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs.

 - Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market.

 - Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity.

What we’re looking for

 - 1+ year of SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required).

 - A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging.

 - High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales.

 - High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities.

 - Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management.

How we work

 - We’re an in-office team in New York. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

 - This is a high-performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

 - There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

What you can expect

 - Equity: Stock options with real upside.

 - Market: Strong demand and engaged buyers facing real pain.

 - Training: Direct mentorship from sales leadership and close collaboration with AEs.

 - Progression: A clear, performance-based path to Account Executive and beyond.

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, master the fundamentals of tech sales, and grow quickly in a high-bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

MUST BE AUTHORIZED TO WORK IN THE USA

Second shift position: Monday through Thursday 4:30PM - 5:00AM

SHIFT DIFFERENTIAL

As Laborer you will be assigned to various production related tasks including drilling, cutting, bending, shaping, grinding, fitting, assembly, cleaning, scrap removal, tacking, burning, and moving material. You can learn the basics of specific jobs and operate basic machinery and tools following proper training.

Essential Functions

• Operate magnetic drills
• Torque bolts
• Grind steel products using various sized grinders
• Operate cutting and heating torches
• Layout, position, align, and fit together the fabricated parts of structural components according to shop drawing or prints and layout specifications
• Tack welding
• Unload raw materials and load finished steel products with the use of a forklift (requires completion of proper training and certification)
• Perform trash and scrap removal; general cleaning and housekeeping in the shop as directed; run errands and perform in-house deliveries as necessary
• Handle, move and turn production materials with overhead cranes
• Stud weld and operate a stud welding machine
• Perform other job duties as assigned

• Ability to work independently without direct supervision and as a team member
• Ability to read and speak English
• High school graduate or GED (preferred)
• Experience in structural steel operations (preferred)

Physical Demands

The ability to stand continuously is essential, with occasional walking and sitting. Repetitive motions of the hands, arms and upper body are frequently required. The nature of the position will require the employee to perform/maintain occasional awkward body positions including kneeling, bending and reaching. The range of physical activities includes pushing and pulling, operating mechanically assisted materials handling equipment, lifting and carrying heavy objects (60-100 lb) climbing and crouching. Vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus.

Work Environment

The employee works near moving mechanical parts and in outside weather conditions; is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles; is occasionally exposed to risk of electrical shock; is occasionally exposed to risk of flash burn of eyes and exposed skin; the noise level of the work environment is usually very loud.

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Enterprise customers want to unlock the power of AI while maintaining the security, governance, compliance, and administrative controls they expect from Box. As AI agents become capable of accessing enterprise content and taking actions across business workflows, these capabilities become even more critical.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead AI Infrastructure and Compliance — a foundational product area for delivering enterprise-grade AI and enabling some of Box’s most strategic customers to adopt AI at scale.

You will define how organizations govern AI across Box: how AI activity is permissioned, stored, audited, and controlled; how agents are protected against AI-specific security risks; how administrators set guardrails and model policies; and how Box AI meets demanding regulatory and compliance requirements such as FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, and Export Control. You will also shape how AI integrates with Box’s existing Governance and Shield capabilities so customers can extend the policies they already trust to AI-powered experiences.

This is a broad and technically complex product area that sits at the intersection of AI, security, content permissions, governance, and platform architecture. You’ll work closely with architects, engineering leaders, security and compliance teams, and product teams across Box to establish common capabilities that can be consistently applied across Box AI experiences.

If you enjoy solving technically deep platform problems, bringing clarity to ambiguous spaces, and aligning teams around architectural decisions that unlock major customer opportunities, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own the strategy and roadmap for AI Infrastructure to support that AI has the right AI Admin, Governance & Compliance, defining the foundational controls enterprises need to deploy AI and agents securely and at scale.

• Define how AI sessions and agent activity are permissioned, stored, and governed across Box products, including experiences such as Box Automate.

• Build enterprise-grade auditability and observability for AI, enabling customers to understand and govern how users and agents interact with enterprise content.

• Define Box’s Agent platform approach for handing AI security use cases.

• Build administrative controls for model selection and policy enforcement, giving organizations control over which AI models can be used based on their security, compliance, and business requirements.

• Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Product and Engineering to meet requirements including FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, Export Control, EU AI Act, and other enterprise and government standards.

• Partner with SEC Product to define how existing Box Governance and Box Shield policies extend to AI and agent experiences, creating a consistent governance model across content, users, and agents.

• Establish common platform capabilities and policies that work consistently across Box agents, Box Automate, and third-party agents accessing Box through MCP.

• Partner deeply with enterprise architects and engineering leaders on complex areas including Box’s file system, permissions, agent identity and authorization, and AI security architecture.

• Drive alignment across multiple product and engineering organizations, resolving architectural and product trade-offs and establishing clear ownership across shared platform capabilities.

• Work directly with strategic enterprise customers and GTM teams to understand AI governance requirements, unblock adoption, and translate customer needs into scalable platform capabilities.

• Communicate strategy, architectural trade-offs, roadmap priorities, and outcomes clearly to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage models and lifecycles for models to ensure model neutrality and compliance for our customers.

WHO YOU ARE

• You have 7+ years of product management experience, including significant experience owning technically complex platform, security, governance, compliance, infrastructure, or enterprise products.

• You have a strong technical foundation and can engage deeply with architects and senior engineers on system architecture, APIs, identity and permissions, data models, and platform trade-offs.

• You understand enterprise security, governance, and compliance and can translate complex requirements into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off solutions.

• You have experience with, or a strong understanding of, AI/ML systems and emerging AI security risks, particularly those associated with agents, tool use, permissions, and autonomous actions.

• You are comfortable navigating complex systems involving content storage, permissions, identity, authorization, auditability, and policy enforcement.

• You have demonstrated success driving products that require coordination across multiple engineering and product teams, where ownership and technical dependencies extend beyond a single team.

• You can operate effectively at Staff level: defining strategy in ambiguous spaces, identifying the most important problems, making difficult prioritization decisions, and influencing leaders without relying on organizational authority.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate complex technical and compliance topics into clear decisions for engineers, customers, executives, and other stakeholders.

• You have experience working directly with large enterprise customers and understand the security, governance, and administrative requirements that influence enterprise technology adoption.

• Experience with FedRAMP, DoD impact levels, export controls, data governance, DLP, or security policy platforms is a strong plus.

• Experience building AI agents, AI platforms, security or compliance products, or enterprise content systems is a strong plus.

• We are an AI-first company. You approach your work with a growth mindset and actively leverage AI to make faster, smarter decisions and increase your impact.
