jobs.title: Senior Regulatory and Securities Attorney
jobs.description:
Flow Traders is seeking an experienced Senior Regulatory & Securities Attorney to serve as senior in-house legal advisor on U.S. securities law across its ETF, cash equity, digital-asset, and tokenization businesses.

This role will provide legal guidance to trading, business, and operations teams; supports  transactional and regulatory legal work; advise on regulatory developments and new business initiatives; and help manage legal risk in a complex, fast-paced, and internationally integrated new environment.

The candidate will work closely with Compliance, Risk, and Business Development, while operating as an integrated member of Flow Traders’ global Legal team. The role will have a  meaningful focus on digital assets, tokenization, market structure, and the application of securities laws to emerging financial products and infrastructure.

What you will do

• Serve as lead in-house resource on U.S. securities law, including the Securities Act of 1933, Exchange Act of 1934, Investment Advisers Act, and applicable FINRA/SEC rules.

• Advise business, trading, and operations teams on broker-dealer regulatory requirements, trading practices, and new product development.

• Provide legal guidance on digital asset classification, tokenized securities, and application of securities frameworks to blockchain-based products.

• Monitor SEC, FINRA, CFTC, and FinCEN developments; interpret and communicate implications to internal stakeholders.

• Advise on structuring and launch of new business lines, products, and geographic expansion.

• Identify legal and regulatory risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.

• Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including trading, vendor, technology, and partnership agreements.

• Provide legal support for strategic transactions, including investments, joint ventures, and acquisitions involving digital-asset businesses or infrastructure.

• Develop and maintain standard-form agreements, legal playbooks, And knowledge-sharing resources.

• Collaborate with Global Legal team to promote consistent processes and legal standards across jurisdictions.

• Manage relationships with outside counsel, including matter scoping, work allocation, and legal spend.

• Work alongside existing Legal Counsel and other members of the legal team, providing substantive input, collaboration, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing.

What you need to succeed

• Required J.D. from an accredited law school; active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar (New York strongly preferred). 6 + years of relevant legal experience, with a preference for candidates whose experience reflects substantial hands-on responsibility in a complex, fast-paced regulatory environment. Significant experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house at a financial services firm, broker-dealer, trading firm, or regulatory agency (SEC, FINRA, CFTC). Deep expertise in U.S. federal securities law, including SEC and FINRA rules applicable to broker-dealers. Experience advising on digital assets, cryptocurrency, or blockchain-related legal matters, including token classification, DeFi, and application of securities laws to digital-asset products. Strong understanding of trading and market structure, including equity, fixed income, and/or ETP markets. Excellent written/verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complex legal issues for non-legal audiences. Strong stakeholder-management skills, sound organizational judgment, and sensitivity to organizational dynamics. A proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented communication style.

• Preferred Experience at or advising a proprietary trading firm, market maker, or exchange. Familiarity with AML/BSA requirements as applied to broker-dealers and digital-asset businesses. Experience with cross-border securities law issues and international regulatory frameworks. Exposure to investment adviser regulations, commodity trading advisor rules, or derivatives/swaps regulatory frameworks. Experience working as part of a global or multinational Legal function. Prior experience mentoring or supervising junior attorneys or legal professionals.

At Flow Traders, we acknowledge the importance of open and transparent communication whether it be with our employees, our stakeholders, or our local and global communities. When it comes to salary, Flow Traders uses reliable market research to create base ranges. Where candidates will fall within the range depends on a few different factors including but not limited to level of experience, location, and specific skill set. We also consider ourselves one global team, and to demonstrate that, all employees are eligible to share in the company’s success through an annual discretionary variable remuneration allocated based on company, group and individual performance and contribution.

Per NYC salary transparency law, the total compensation for this role includes a base range of $200,000 to $250,000 plus annual discretionary variable remuneration.

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

 - Define and enforce quality bars for multilingual corpora, including translation quality, cultural fidelity, toxicity, and contamination checks.

 - Design and run scientific experiments to advance our understanding of scaling large language models to improve multilingual data efficiency.

 - Lead small research projects independently while collaborating on larger initiatives.

 - Build evaluation sets and diagnostics that expose where model behavior degrades by language, register, or domain, and close those gaps with targeted data.

 - Work with pre-training, mid-training, and post-training teams to land measurable, step-function improvements in multilingual capability.



About You

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and comfort processing web-scale datasets in distributed environments.

 - Experience building large-scale data pipelines for language models, machine translation, speech, or search — ideally covering more than one language.

 - Fluency or working proficiency in at least one language other than English, and genuine curiosity about how languages differ.

 - A rigorous, measurement-first mindset: you prove a data change helped rather than assuming it did.

 - Navigate trade-offs between research objectives and practical engineering realities.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and high ownership in a small, fast-moving team. Passionate about advancing the frontier of intelligence.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related discipline.

 - Published work in multilingual NLP, low-resource languages, or evaluation methodology.

 - Experience with annotation vendor management or crowdsourced data operations at scale.

 - Familiarity with tokenizer design and its effects on non-Latin scripts.


WHAT WE OFFER:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

 - Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.

Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Director of Demand Generation to own the global demand generation function for Pacvue's enterprise business, reporting into our SVP of Marketing. This role owns the demand engine end-to-end, the pipeline, the program budget, and distinct growth channels: paid media, lifecycle marketing and integrated campaigns, industry demand generation partnerships, and our paid referral program.

The Senior Director will lead the demand generation organization through a team of managers and ICs, each owning a discipline, and will set the global demand methodology, standards, and measurement that regional teams execute against. As the senior voice for demand generation, you will reconcile competing priorities across sales, product, regional leadership, and global functional heads, and you will be the single point of accountability for marketing pipeline across every channel that generates it.

This is a role for someone who is equal parts strategist, operator, and dealmaker. You will decide where our demand dollars go, set the campaign and lifecycle strategy that carries prospects from first touch to closed-won, and personally build the partner and referral relationships that put Pacvue in front of buyers we cannot reach on our own.

Responsibilities:

• Set and own the global demand generation strategy, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting against pipeline and revenue targets

• Establish the methodology the demand function runs on globally; campaign frameworks, performance standards, channel playbooks, and measurement

• Partner with regional marketing leaders, including the Director of EMEA Marketing, so global campaigns land with regional market fit and sales alignment.

• Own paid strategy across search, social, display, and content syndication, with Google Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn as core channels, holding the team to targets for CPL, cost per opportunity, and ROAS on pipeline

• Own the lifecycle strategy across email, nurture, and in-product touchpoints, building segmented programs that convert existing database demand rather than only buying new leads

• Partner with Product Marketing to turn positioning and messaging frameworks into campaigns that convert, and with Content and Events so every program lands as one coherent story

• Align demand generation goals with Sales leadership on shared definitions and targets; own the lead-to-opportunity handoff and support SDR/BDR effectiveness

• Own industry partnerships as a demand channel — identify, negotiate, and scale co-marketing relationships with retailers, technology partners, agencies, and industry media that generate qualified pipeline

• Own the paid referral program end-to-end: partner recruitment, incentive and commission structure, enablement, tracking, payout operations, and performance reporting

• Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance on partner agreements, referral terms, deal registration, and attribution of partner-sourced pipeline

• Manage through leaders — set direction and standards for disciplines you do not execute yourself, and develop your managers into stronger leaders

• Measure demand performance and ROI through data analytics; provide regular reporting to leadership on funnel health across all regions

• Drive a continuous testing agenda across channels, audiences, creative, and landing page conversion, and improve lead quality at every stage handoff in partnership with Sales and Marketing Operations

Skills & Qualifications:

• 12+ years of marketing experience with deep specialization in B2B demand generation or growth. This role requires career depth in the demand discipline itself, not oversight of it as one of several functions

• Senior leadership responsibility for a global or multi-region functional area, owning the standards and measurement regional teams operate against

• Proven experience leading demand generation teams through a layer of managers

• Demonstrated ownership of a demand budget and pipeline target across multiple channels simultaneously; breadth across the funnel, not depth in one channel alone

• Deep, hands-on performance marketing background, with significant paid budgets owned across Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Bing

• Strong lifecycle and nurture expertise, with working command of marketing automation and Salesforce CRM

• Experience building co-marketing, channel, affiliate, or referral programs as a measurable source of pipeline, including structuring the incentives and negotiating the agreements behind them

• Strong analytical skills with real fluency in funnel math and attribution

• Experience working in matrix organizations and driving alignment with regional counterparts you do not directly manage

• Strong expertise in B2B marketing (SaaS, eCommerce, retail media, or commerce advertising preferred); experience in a scale-up environment

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, results-driven environment

• Ability to challenge the "status-quo" and not be afraid to test new, bold ideas

Benefits:

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays

• Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance

• 401k with Employer Match

• Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization

• Paid Parental Leave

• Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton

• Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual base salary range for this position is $180,000-$215,000 USD. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.

#LI-Remote

Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: SaaS and Vendor Manager
jobs.description:
SaaS and Vendor Manager

El Segundo, California, United States

CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries is seeking a hands-on Saas and Vendor Manager to own governance of our vendor ecosystem, from sourcing and contract negotiation through ongoing performance, risk, and financial oversight. You'll build the frameworks that give leadership real visibility into vendor risk, vendor performance, and the financial return each vendor delivers to the business.

This role reports to the IT/Cybersecurity Program Director. You'll manage vendor relationships spanning, including consulting, implementation, managed services, and support, partnering closely with corporate procurement and Business Technology (BT) stakeholders to keep sourcing decisions, contractual commitments, and delivery outcomes aligned to CHAOS Industries' objectives.

Responsibilities:

Vendor Governance & Strategy

• Oversee all aspects of vendor relationships, including consulting, implementation, managed services, and support services.

• Lead strategic oversight and performance governance of enterprise vendors, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Serve as the primary interface between vendor leadership, IT service owners, and stakeholders.

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies that reduce costs while increasing value.

• Cost management by tracking spend against budget, identifying consolidation opportunities, benchmarking pricing against market rates

Performance & Service Delivery

• Define and monitor vendor performance expectations and KPIs.

• Monitor vendor performance, manage escalations, and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.

• Drive accountability and cross-functional remediation of performance gaps.

• Ensure vendor delivery supports reliability, user experience, and business continuity objectives.

• Reconcile IT department credit card transactions weekly against approved purchase requests, open POs, and budget lines, resolving discrepancies

Sourcing, Contracts & Procurement

• Assist procurement in the negotiation of contracts, SLAs, and KPIs with service providers to ensure alignment with company goals.

• Assist corporate procurement and lead stakeholders through RFPs, RFIs, and other procurement processes for services.

• Enforce contractual obligations and ensure alignment between delivery execution and agreed terms.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant procurement policies.

Risk & Compliance

• Assess and manage vendor cyber, operational, financial, and reputational risk.

• Identify and mitigate risks associated with service vendors, including financial, compliance, and operational risks.

Insights, Reporting & Financial Oversight

• Develop and maintain dashboards/scorecards for the IT/Cybersecurity Leadership to track vendor performance and inform decisions.

• Regularly review and report on vendor performance metrics against set benchmarks, providing regular reporting to the Program Director.

• Translate analytics into actionable insights; identify systemic risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

• Use data-driven insights to influence vendor selection and management strategies.

• Partner with Finance and Procurement to manage vendor financial performance and discipline.

Stakeholder Engagement & Workforce Strategy

• Cultivate strong, strategic partnerships with key vendors to enhance business capabilities and innovation.

• Facilitate communication between vendors, Business Technology (BT) teams, and other stakeholders to ensure project success and alignment with business strategy.

• Collaborate with BT stakeholders to shape an effective workforce mix of internal team members and professional services labor.

• Lead vendor business reviews and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships.

• Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field.

• Has directly managed vendor relationships such as consulting, implementation, managed services, or support.

• Has negotiated or materially contributed to negotiating contracts, SLAs, and KPIs with technology service providers.

• Has led or substantially supported RFP/RFI processes or other formal procurement activities.

• Working knowledge of commercial agreements and contractual governance.

• Strong financial acumen, including cost analysis and value tracking.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and influence skills, with experience managing escalations across vendor and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

• Experience shaping workforce strategies that blend internal staff with or contract labor.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 350 employees and counting across 5 global offices

Base Salary Range: $130,000 - 180,000

jobs.title: Research Coordinator, Science
jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Research Coordinator to join our Research Operations team on a fixed-term contract in Oulu. This team leads a variety of research studies, both internal and external, to develop new features and continue to enhance the accuracy of our algorithms. Our partnerships often lead to scientific publications and provide public validation of Oura’s health sensing capabilities. You will support our team with ongoing internal human research studies.

Our fixed-term period is planned to be 10 months, timing can be agreed between 11/2026- 08/2027. This is a mostly onsite role based in Oulu, which will involve commuting into our office multiple times per week.

What You'll Do:

• Run in-person data collections, including scheduling, room and equipment setup, participant flow, and accurate capture of data from the Oura Ring and reference devices.

• Manage prototypes and research equipment, troubleshooting functionality issues.

• Co-author protocols and SOPs in collaboration with researchers and data scientists.

• Track study milestones, proactively flag blockers, and keep studies moving on time.

• Perform manual data quality control and collaborate with engineers to build automated checks.

• Ensure compliance with research ethics, Good Clinical Practice, and Oura’s internal standards.

We would love to have you in our team if You have:

• Studies from human research (e.g., biology, psychology, cognitive science, biomedical engineering) and in your final stages (4th+ year / 250 ECTS).

• Familiarity with research ethics and good clinical practice

• Strong attention to detail and confidence managing timelines and documentation

• Good communication skills (in English)

• Ability to work independently and adapt to changing situation

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Breach Readiness Consultant, you will be tasked with supporting the delivery of cutting edge cybersecurity incident preparation and knowledge building services, and with helping push the limits of preparedness by simulating realistic breaches, combining both technical and communication skills to make a lasting impact.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Assist with the delivery of industry-leading Breach Readiness services, including workshops, tabletops, war rooms, and purple teams.

• Support the publication of detailed and impactful deliverables, including lessons-learned reports and security improvement recommendations.

• Contribute to the design and improvement of services, based on threat trends, intelligence, and customer feedback.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• Experience delivering incident response exercises or security awareness training.

• Proven ability to present technical information to diverse audiences.

• Enthusiastic, driven and confident, with the ability to clearly and persuasively articulate the company's mission, product and business opportunity.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Salary starting from 3000 EUR/month. Annual bonus based on company performance, paid in two installments. The final base salary may be adjusted based on the individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Product Intelligence Analytics
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This is a Senior Product Analytics role focused on understanding how our products are used across Axon's ecosystem. You will partner closely with a Senior Analytics Engineer to shape shared analytics capabilities — metric frameworks, context modeling standards, and reporting conventions — that keep product data consistent and trustworthy across teams.

Within that shared foundation, you'll also go deep on one or more specific products or business pillars — owning the full arc from defining what to measure and ensuring it lands correctly, through to the analysis and judgment that shape high-stakes product decisions.

You'll work in close, ongoing partnership with product managers, acting as their analytical thought partner on product adoption, engagement, and go-to-market strategy — starting by pressure-testing the question itself, not just answering what's asked.

You'll also help define how AI and agentic systems consume and act on our product analytics — what data, context, and guardrails an agent needs to reason reliably about product usage, and where automation can extend analyst judgment.

Success in this role comes from strong analytical judgment and genuine curiosity about the product and business, not from engineering credentials. You're someone who thinks like an analyst first. You have the instinct and ability to stop or redirect analysis when it becomes clear it's answering the wrong question, rather than seeing it through to a technically complete but low-impact deliverable. You’re comfortable with SQL and data modeling as tools in service of insight, not as an end in themselves. You reach for statistical techniques — segmentation, experimentation, forecasting — when they sharpen the answer, and you pick the simplest one that builds conviction quickly, not the most sophisticated one available. Because this is an applied, decision-focused role, not a research role, it requires strong influencing and communication skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.

What You'll Do

Location: This role follows a hybrid schedule and is based out of our Seattle office. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation.

Reports to: Principal Product Manager, Analytics

Direct Reports: None – this is an individual contributor role

• Serve as the analytical thought partner to product managers — pressure-testing whether we're asking the right question before scoping any analysis, and proactively surfacing risks or leading indicators stakeholders haven't asked about. This role is expected to function as an early-warning system, not only respond to requests.

• Partner with product managers to define what needs to be measured, specify event taxonomy and tracking requirements, and validate the data lands correctly — turning that foundation into the models and analysis that drive high-quality, high-velocity decisions.

• Build and maintain durable data models and applied analyses — using statistical methods (segmentation, forecasting, experimentation) where they add rigor — that transform raw telemetry into business-aligned insight, favoring clear, purpose-built analysis over generic dashboards or one-off exploratory work.

• Explore and apply how AI agents can perform or accelerate analytics work — from natural-language querying to automated anomaly detection and insight generation. Define the data structures and documentation that make product analytics legible and reliable for agents, not just humans.

• Work alongside a senior analytics engineer to define and evolve shared metric definitions, semantic layer conventions, and reporting standards. Contribute to the conventions that keep metrics consistent and prevent drift as the organization grows.

• Maintain data quality standards, testing practices, and documentation norms for your area of ownership. Reduce reliance on tribal knowledge by keeping analysis and definitions discoverable and well-documented.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in product analytics or a closely related role, with strong exposure to user engagement and product adoption measurement, ideally in fast-paced, high-growth SaaS or enterprise B2B environments.

• Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, plus working knowledge of programming for analytical workflows.

• Direct experience with user engagement metrics (activation, retention, stickiness, feature adoption) and genuine interest in how products earn ongoing use.

• Experience defining metric frameworks and shared definitions that hold up across teams.

• Comfortable applying statistical techniques — experimentation design, causal inference, forecasting — matching rigor to the stakes rather than defaulting to the most advanced method; includes hands-on experience supporting experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, feature flags).

• Familiarity with enterprise B2B go-to-market motions — how adoption, expansion, and engagement metrics connect to sales, customer success, and renewal cycles.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with product managers as a thought partner (not an order-taker), including navigating ownership with stakeholders when something looks under-addressed — usually without direct authority over their roadmap.

• Genuine curiosity and hands-on exploration of AI/LLM agents for analytics — natural-language querying, automated reporting, anomaly detection, agentic workflows — with a point of view on what data/context agents need to be effective, and thoughtful views on their current limits.

• Experience in a native cloud data stack (e.g., AWS-based tooling) — not required, but a plus.

• Passion for public safety, social impact, or building products that make a difference.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. $123,750—$198,000 USD

jobs.title: VP Brand
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPERPOWER

Superpower is building a new health system to extend and enhance human life. We bring testing, personalized insights and ongoing care together to help people understand their health and take action earlier.

Our challenge is to make proactive healthcare understandable, desirable and trusted enough that people choose to act. We want Superpower to become the brand people turn to when they decide to take ownership of their health.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a VP Brand to make Superpower a widely recognized and trusted health brand that people actively seek out.

You’ll own our brand strategy, integrated campaign roadmap and brand investment plan. Your job is to give people a clear reason to choose Superpower, bring that story to new audiences and build a stronger connection between the brand and the people we serve.

You’ll be accountable for the journey from customer insight to campaign idea, creative development, distribution and results. That means deciding which audiences and opportunities deserve our attention, setting the standard for the work and building the team and partner network to deliver it.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll write briefs, shape messaging, review copy and design, work with production partners and get campaigns into the world.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Brand strategy and positioning. Own the audience priorities, positioning and messaging that guide our brand work. Turn customer research, cultural insight and the realities of the product into a clear, differentiated reason to choose Superpower.

 - Integrated campaigns from idea to impact. Set the campaign calendar and lead work from brief through production, launch and evaluation. Give every campaign a clear audience, idea, distribution plan and intended business outcome.

 - Brand expression and creative standards. Set the brief and quality bar for brand campaigns. Work directly with copy, design and production specialists to make the work recognizable, memorable and true to Superpower. Build a brand system that helps teams make strong decisions as our offering grows.

 - Sustained visibility and demand. Build a plan for how people encounter Superpower between major campaigns. Connect content, creators, member stories, cultural partnerships and earned attention with campaign activity, working with the owners of those channels. Use brand media and events where they meaningfully extend the idea and reach the right audience.

 - Brand investment and measurement. Own the brand budget, prioritize investments and explain the tradeoffs. Establish a view of awareness, consideration, branded search and qualified demand, and work with Growth to assess how brand activity contributes to new-member acquisition.

 - The team and operating process. Build and lead the brand team and external partner network. Set priorities, develop talent and establish a clear process for briefs, creative reviews, production and learning.

You’ll partner with Paid Media on amplification and acquisition measurement, and with Product, Clinical and Member Experience to ensure our promises are credible and reflected in the service people receive.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - You have owned a consumer-brand function. You’ve been accountable for its strategy, budget, team and results, with experience making decisions through a period of meaningful growth.

 - You have taken distinctive work all the way to market. You can show campaigns or launches you personally led, explain the customer insight and creative decisions, and describe how the work reached its audience.

 - You can demonstrate business impact. You can explain what changed in awareness, consideration, customer demand or acquisition, the evidence behind that conclusion and your own contribution.

 - You have strong creative judgment and can improve the work yourself. You write useful briefs, recognize a strong idea and give precise feedback across copy, design and storytelling. You can simplify a complex health offering without losing its substance.

 - You have built teams and delivered through them. You know how to hire and develop strong people, choose external specialists and keep quality high when time and resources are limited.

 - You combine cultural awareness with commercial discipline. You understand where a brand belongs, which opportunities to pursue and how to make an investment case. You’re comfortable defending your judgment and changing course when the evidence warrants it.

 - You care about health and the customer. You want to understand what people need, what they believe and what would help them take action.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in consumer health, wellness, subscriptions or another category where trust and education influence the purchase.

 - Experience taking a brand from an engaged early audience to broader consumer recognition.

 - Work that connects cultural partnerships, community or member advocacy with measurable demand.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - More of our target audience knows Superpower, understands why it matters and considers becoming a member.

 - Distinctive campaigns and a sustained brand presence bring qualified new audiences into the business.

 - Brand investments show evidence of contributing to demand and acquisition, with clear decisions about what to repeat, improve or stop.

 - The team delivers strong work consistently, and the brand becomes clearer and more recognizable as the business grows.


WHY SUPERPOWER

 - Help make proactive healthcare a choice more people understand and want to make.

 - Shape a consumer brand whose promise is experienced through an ongoing health relationship.

 - Work with leaders who contribute directly to the work, with the autonomy and responsibility to see your decisions through.


ABOUT SUPERPOWER

Superpower is a new health system on a mission to extend and enhance human life.

We started with lab testing, then data aggregation / digital twin, then an AI doctor, and now peptides.

Over the past 6 months, we have grown 10x whilst halving CAC. Now we are gearing up for hyper growth.


You can find more about us below:

Company Philosophies

 - We are all here to genuinely do our life’s best work

 - Insanely high talent bar, never settling. A players only (see Steve Jobs https://twitter.com/founderspodcast/status/1665442439715225600?s=46&t=PK-vWojaLurY6eXl341Thw)

 - We live to work as much as we work to live. But we sustainably espouse the superpower ethos of putting health first

 - We aim to set the gold standard for team health culture on the planet — live the ethos!



Investors

jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description:

As a Software Development Engineer in this role, you will focus on designing and implementing robust event-driven architectures that enhance observability and enable comprehensive tracking of events across diverse data pipelines. Your work will involve developing modular systems that support seamless integration with new data formats and domains, ensuring scalability and adaptability as business needs evolve. You will be responsible for building solutions that prioritize access control, fault tolerance, and real-time alerting, all while maintaining high standards for record keeping in a digital environment.

Leveraging your expertise, you will help create frameworks that allow for granular monitoring and rapid response to system events, supporting the organization’s commitment to operational excellence. To excel in this position, you should be comfortable working with technologies such as Python for asynchronous and concurrent programming, Kafka for distributed messaging, and JSON for data interchange. Familiarity with observability tools like Grafana and the ELK stack will be essential for building dashboards and monitoring system health. Experience with distributed systems, event-driven design patterns, and implementing fault-tolerant architectures will be highly beneficial. Exposure to best practices in modular software design, access management, and scalable pipeline development will further support your success as you contribute to expanding the organization’s data infrastructure.

Here's what you'll need:

• 8+ years of experience in software development or a related field.

• Experience in the following areas: Python Kafka Distributed Systems Event-Driven Design Asynchronous Coding Concurrency JSON Fault Tolerance Observability Grafana ELK

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with access control in event-driven architectures

• Expertise in modular system design for data pipelines

• Familiarity with alerting and record-keeping solutions

• Knowledge of expanding architectures to support multiple data domains and formats

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Mechanical Technician is responsible for performing both basic and complex diagnostics and on agricultural and lifting equipment. Starting wage from $16.50 - $24 / hour!   The Mechanical Technician is responsible to perform repairs and maintenance on both customer-owned, or dealer-owned, equipment, including corn headers, other combine headers, and a variety of other agricultural implements. In addition, maintenance will be performed on the fleet of vehicles and lifting equipment the company uses.  The Mechanical Technician is responsible for ensuring a clean and safe work environment, continually develop technical skills with evolving products, and perform work at customers sites as required.

Job Responsibilities:

• Equipment and Tools: Maintains good condition and cleanliness of company vehicles inventory, tools, and equipment, including the return of tools to storage areas.

• Service Diagnostics: Performs basic / complex diagnostics on agricultural / construction / diesel equipment, determining what repairs are needed and/or recommended for future attention / maintenance. This can be for either customer-owned equipment located at the shop or at the customer’s site, or dealer-owned equipment (inspections).
• Service Paperwork: Completes all reports and forms for service operations in a timely and accurate manner. This would include inspection reports, work orders, etc. Uses computers/tablets for data entry as required. Ensure management is aware of any issues/surprises which can impact customer billing or satisfaction. Ensures accurate timekeeping for job costing.
• Service Repairs: Performs repairs on above equipment (electrical, hydraulic, mechanical, diesel) as requested. Accountable for performing quality work and attaining stated goals for efficiency.
• Service Training / Development: Participates in all requested job-related training and development, as well as taking an active interest in improving skills with other training programs.
• Teamwork: Works collaboratively with other technicians, parts, and sales personnel. Mentors Mechanical Technician Apprentices and junior Technicians as able. Works after hours (daily or weekend) as required.

• Ability to lift 75 pounds as required without assistance

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to COO
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, industry partners, nonprofit organizations, and other external contacts.
• Make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.
• Maintain professional relationship continuity on behalf of the COO.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Take clear meeting notes and turn discussions into organized action items.
• Keep project information, notes, and supporting documents organized.
• Update customer records, notes, CRM information, and project information when requested.

Administrative & Business Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and other documents.
• Organize and maintain electronic files and records.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with internal and external meetings, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.
• Provide administrative support for industry associations, nonprofit initiatives, and other organizational activities.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Assist with changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Executive Assistant at Bish does more than complete assigned tasks.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.
• Notices when something is incomplete and works to resolve it.
• Keeps commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is needed.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally with different personalities and departments.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage interruptions and changing priorities without losing organization.
• Identifies practical solutions instead of simply reporting problems.
• Pays close attention to details while still understanding the larger priority.
• Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
• Knows when to take initiative and when to ask for direction.
• Is reliable, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

Required

• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, or in a closely related support role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external partners.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Able to work on-site at our Giltner, Nebraska location.

Preferred

• Experience directly supporting a COO, CEO, business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive.
• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes.
• Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments.
• Experience with CRM systems.
• Experience with project-management tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms.
• Experience in sales support, marketing, public relations, business operations, or customer communication.
• Experience coordinating travel, conferences, events, or speaking engagements.
• Spanish language skills.
• Interest in agriculture, manufacturing, agricultural equipment, sustainability, or mission-driven organizations.

Agricultural experience is helpful but not required. We are more interested in finding someone who can learn quickly, understand the business, and become a reliable and increasingly independent partner to the COO.

Schedule

• Approximately 30–40+ hours per week, depending on workload and business needs.

jobs.title: Sales Team Coordinator | ON-SITE
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Sales Team Coordinator to support and coordinate the daily activities of our sales team.

This is a hands-on sales support, customer service, and people-coordination position. The employee will help organize priorities, monitor assignments, follow up with team members, coordinate communication, and make sure sales-related tasks continue moving forward.

The Sales Team Coordinator serves as a central point of communication between sales representatives, customers, management, and other departments.

Work Location

This is a full-time, on-site position located at:

508 S D Road

Giltner, Nebraska 68841

The employee is expected to work from the Bish Enterprises office during normal working hours.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to the Giltner office.

A company laptop may be provided for business use. Receiving a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Travel Requirement

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include:

• Customer visits
• Trade shows
• Agricultural events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Training
• Sales meetings
• Dealer visits
• Other company-related activities

Travel may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, or overnight stays.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

jobs.title: Remote Executive Assistant to COO
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Remote Executive Assistant to provide independent contractor services supporting our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This engagement is more than task management. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep projects and follow-ups moving across the organization.

The right person will become a trusted remote partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

Because this work is fully remote, strong self-management, responsiveness, organization, and follow-through are especially important.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage the COO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, speaking engagements, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO’s time.
• Ensure the COO has necessary documents, notes, links, background information, and supporting materials before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Inbox, Communication & Follow-Up

• Maintain and organize the COO’s email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, quotes, presentations, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, partners, industry organizations, nonprofit stakeholders, and other external contacts.
• Maintain relationship continuity and make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Help ensure important messages and requests do not get overlooked.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up on projects with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Follow up on outstanding action items until they are completed or resolved.
• Take clear meeting notes and organize discussions into action items.
• Maintain organized project notes, files, and supporting information.
• Upload and organize customer records, notes, CRM updates, and other business information when requested.

Business, Industry & Organizational Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and supporting documents.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with event, conference, travel, and speaking-engagement logistics.
• Provide administrative assistance for industry organizations, nonprofit initiatives, legislative or advocacy activities, and related projects.
• Help coordinate communication across organizations and external stakeholders.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Support changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Remote Executive Assistant at Bish does more than wait for individual tasks to be assigned.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through consistently.
• Notices when something is incomplete, unanswered, or approaching a deadline.
• Keeps commitments and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Can independently prioritize multiple requests.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is necessary.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally in both written and verbal communication.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage changing priorities without losing organization.
• Looks for practical solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
• Works effectively without micromanagement.
• Maintains responsiveness and accountability in a remote environment.
• Knows when to use independent judgment and when clarification is needed.
• Handles confidential information with discretion.

Required

• Fluent professional English and Spanish, written and spoken.
• Currently located in Central or South America.
• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or in a closely related support role.
• Previous experience working successfully in a remote environment.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written communication and proofreading skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external organizations.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
• Reliable internet access and an appropriate remote working environment.
• Ability to maintain meaningful availability for collaboration during agreed-upon hours overlapping with the U.S. Central Time Zone.

Preferred

• Experience directly supporting a COO, CEO, founder, entrepreneur, or senior executive.
• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes remotely.
• Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments.
• Experience with CRM systems.
• Familiarity with project-management tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, or similar systems.
• Experience in sales support, marketing, public relations, customer communication, or business operations.
• Experience coordinating travel, conferences, events, or speaking engagements.
• Interest in agriculture, sustainability, agricultural equipment, manufacturing, hemp, or mission-driven organizations.

Agricultural experience is not required. The ability to learn quickly, understand executive priorities, communicate professionally, and become increasingly independent is more important.

Contractor Engagement

• This opportunity is structured as an independent contractor engagement, not employment with Bish Enterprises.
• The contractor will provide services remotely from their country of residence.
• Compensation is USD $8–$12 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.
• The anticipated workload is approximately 30–40 hours per week, depending on workload and business needs. Hours may vary and are not guaranteed.
• Meaningful availability during agreed-upon hours overlapping with the U.S. Central Time Zone is required for communication, meetings, and coordination.
• Some flexibility may be necessary for meetings, events, deadlines, travel coordination, or time-sensitive priorities.
• The contractor is responsible for complying with applicable tax, registration, insurance, and other legal obligations associated with independent contractor work in their country of residence.
• As an independent contractor, the individual is not eligible for employee benefits provided by Bish Enterprises.
• The contractor is responsible for maintaining the equipment, internet access, and remote working environment reasonably necessary to perform the services, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

What You’ll Gain

• Fully remote work.
• Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership.
• Exposure to agriculture, manufacturing, business operations, industry organizations, and mission-driven projects.
• A varied engagement involving multiple parts of the business.
• Opportunity to take on greater responsibility as trust and capability develop.
• An environment where initiative, accountability, and strong performance are valued.

To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter in English.

Please include:

• Your current country and time zone.
• Your availability.
• Your experience supporting executives or senior leaders remotely.
• An example of a situation where you independently managed competing priorities, important follow-ups, or a project without close supervision.
• Your level of fluency in English and Spanish.

Bish Enterprises provides equal opportunities to qualified applicants and contractors. Applicant information will be handled confidentially in accordance with applicable guidelines.

jobs.title: Palantir Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Job Description:

The Palantir Platform Engineer assists with integrating custom ETL workflows into the Palantir platform. This includes connecting ETL conditioners to Palantir tooling to increase observability, accelerating data conditioning efforts, and ensuring stakeholders have full insight and knowledge into each step of the transformation process. The Palantir Platform Engineer also uses AI to augment pipelines, increasing the speed and efficiency of data processing efforts while also ensuring to validate products prior to integration into analytics tools for data exploitation.

Your focus on data governance and validation will be essential as you prepare products for integration into advanced analytics tools, ensuring data quality and reliability. Experience with DevOps practices will be valuable as you manage deployment and operational aspects of the platform, while your familiarity with Palantir Foundry and ontology modeling will help you navigate complex data environments. Success in this role will be supported by a strong background in building scalable ETL solutions, implementing monitoring frameworks, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver actionable data insights.

What you'll do:

• Connect ETL conditioners to Palantir tooling, which enhances observability and accelerates data conditioning efforts.

• Ensure that stakeholders maintain comprehensive insight into each phase of the transformation process, leveraging your expertise in data ontology, logging, and monitoring.

• Utilizing your skills in PySpark and Python, you will design and implement robust data pipelines that support seamless data flow and transformation.

• Harness AI to augment and optimize data pipelines, driving greater speed and efficiency in processing large datasets.

Here is what you'll need:

• 8+ years of experience with DevOps practices or a related field.

• Experience in the following areas: Palantir Foundry Strong understanding of Ontology and Data Ontology Expertise in building and integrating ETL Pipelines Proficiency in PySpark and Python Experience with Logging and Monitoring solutions Knowledge of Data Governance best practices Experience leveraging AI to augment data pipelines Strong skills in Validation of data products

Bonus points if you have:

• Bachelor’s Degree

• Experience connecting ETL conditioners to Palantir tooling

• Background in increasing observability and accelerating data conditioning

• Experience ensuring end-to-end insight into data transformation processes

• Familiarity with integrating validated products into analytics tools for data exploitation

Security clearance:
