jobs.title: Senior Manager Operational Quality (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.

Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2025 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.

We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.

Senior Manager Operational Quality (m/f/d)

In this position, you will provide strategic and hands-on leadership for all quality-related matters within your assigned operational areas, ensuring that day-to-day activities consistently comply with cGMP, regulatory requirements and key GSK corporate quality policies. You will exercise independent oversight of GxP processes to drive adherence to cGxP standards and procedures, strengthen the effectiveness of quality in preventing, identifying and resolving quality issues, and foster a proactive quality culture of continuous improvement. By maintaining a strong on-the-floor presence, you will be accountable for critical quality decision-making and manage quality escalations, acting as a visible role model and trusted partner for the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach and develop the Quality Operations team, fostering a high-performance and accountable mindset
• Provide independent quality oversight across manufacturing activities, maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor to identify potential quality issues early
• Make and, where appropriate, escalate key quality decisions, acting as a trusted point of contact for quality-related topics in the operational area
• Ensure effective management and timely closure of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments and product quality reviews
• Maintain continuous inspection readiness and actively support internal audits, self-inspections and health authority inspections
• Represent Quality in site and above-site governance meetings as well as interactions with internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory authorities
• Partner with the business to improve compliance, product quality and overall operational performance through data-driven decisions
• Promote a practical, proactive quality culture built on coaching, accountability and continuous improvement
• Contribute to resources, budget and workforce planning to ensure the Quality Operations team can effectively deliver on its objectives

Qualifications & Skills

• University Degree in natural sciences, engineering or another relevant technical discipline
• Extensive experience in Quality Operations or a comparable role within the pharmaceutical industry
• Strong working knowledge of cGMP and relevant pharmaceutical regulatory requirements
• Proven experience in operational quality oversight, risk management and maintaining inspection readiness
• Demonstrated leadership and coaching capability in a complex, matrixed environment
• Sound judgement and the confidence to make balanced, risk-based quality decisions
• Clear and concise communication skills with the ability to influence effectively across functions and organizational levels
• A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset with a strong commitment to quality and compliance

jobs.description:
Thought Leader Liaison, Gynecological Oncology – Pac South / Southwest

Territory includes but is not limited to: Texas, New Mexico, Arizona, Hawaii, and Southern California.

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL), Gynecological Oncology builds and manages strategic relationships with a select group of U.S. external experts (EEs), with a deliberate focus on cultivating partnerships and insights across both academic and community oncology settings to ensure commercial strategies reflect the realities of where patients receive care.

This role is accountable for generating strategic insights, translating science to actionability, and building brand advocacy. This includes leading strategic engagement with key external experts through robust engagement planning and insight generation aligned to brand and therapeutic area strategies. The TLL generates strategic insights through ongoing interactions with external experts, congresses and executive engagements, while working closely with US/Global Commercial, Medical, and Regulatory partners to translate field perspectives into meaningful business actions that shape brand strategy.

TLLs support the oncology in-line brands within their geography while helping prepare the organization for successful oncology launches through disease-state engagement, external expert partnership, and insights that inform future commercial strategy.

Six geographies will cover the United States, each aligned with an Oncology Field Vice President, who will be an important stakeholder.

Key Responsibilities:

External Expert Engagement & Relationship Management

• Develop and execute strategic external expert engagement plans designed to build long-term partnerships while generating meaningful commercial insights, especially within the community setting.
• Plan and execute External Expert engagements aligned to brand priorities and External Expert needs outside of advisory and congress events, planning and maintaining a consistent level of execution as aligned with TLL Director. This includes a mix of live and virtual engagements in your geography.
• Help create, segment and manage a thought leader network (network mapping) to optimize engagement and insight generation.

Insight Generation & Strategic Impact

• Gather and synthesize regional insights from external experts through forums such as 1:1 interactions, congress, publication, and provide them to the brand team.
• Share synthesized insights with commercial leadership to help shape the following, but not limited to, brand strategy, resource allocation, customer engagement strategies, and launch planning.
• Help identify emerging treatment paradigm shifts in your respective region, competitive dynamics, biomarker evolution, and unmet needs that may influence future commercial strategy.
• Seek compliant External Expert feedback on initiatives and materials.

Advisory, Peer to Peer & Congress Engagements

• Execute and synthesize advisory boards, expert consultancies, and other strategic engagement forums to answer critical business questions and inform commercial decision making.
• Coordinate and support External Expert executive interactions with commercial leadership.
• Shape peer-to-peer education content through speaker identification, training/operations support, and relationship management.
• Participate in key local, regional, and national congresses and serve as onsite host for congress product theater speakers and EEs.
• Capture and synthesize congress insights to identify emerging trends, competitive developments, and implications for brand strategy.

Cross‑Functional & Operational Excellence

• Partner effectively with medical, legal, compliance, regulatory, and marketing teams to ensure external engagements are strategically aligned and within GSK policies and adhering to PHARMA guidelines
• Apply strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Manage agency and vendor partners to ensure timely, high‑quality execution.
• Understand risk associated with the activities on Strategic Engagement and be adept and agile in their management and mitigation.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in field sales, product marketing, or medical/clinical roles within pharma or biotech.
• Oncology experience required.
• Valid driver’s license.
• Willingness to travel 60–80%, including nights and weekends.
• Experience presenting to executive audiences (live and virtual) and influencing strategic decisions or stakeholder alignment.
• Experience leveraging insights to guide strategy development and proactively refine approach in response to evolving data and market dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience as an Oncology TLL
• Master’s degree.
• Strong account management and cross‑functional leadership experience.
• Marketing and/or sales management background.
• Advanced project management and organizational skills.
• Proven adherence to regulatory and compliance standards with proactive risk identification and mitigation.
• Ability to communicate effectively to HCPs and executives.
• Experience and knowledge with technology, software and adaptability to learn new AI tools.

As a Delivery Lead Physical AI, you will manage the planning, execution, and delivery of Physical AI use cases and projects within the global Strategic AI Delivery department. Through the delivery of AI use cases and solutions for Physical AI, you will support the implementation of technologies that contribute to innovation and operational effectiveness across manufacturing, robotics, and automation-related environments.

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of Physical AI use cases and projects within agreed timelines, scope, and budget.

Collaborate with use case sponsors, business stakeholders, IT teams, and Data, Analytics & AI teams to support execution of projects in scope.

Manage external vendors and partners to support successful solution delivery.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Ability to work independently while collaborating across global teams.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline required.
• 3-5 years of progressive HR experience.

Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

LabCorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

LabCorp is seeking a Phlebotomist to join our team in Pineville, Kentucky

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

Job Responsibilities:

• Perform blood collections by venipuncture and capillary techniques for all age groups
• Collect specimens for drug screens, paternity tests, alcohol tests etc.
• Perform data entry of patient information in an accurate and timely manner
• Process billing information and collect payments as necessary
• Prepare all collected specimens for testing and analysis
• Maintain patient and specimen information logs
• Provide superior customer service to all patients
• Administrative and clerical duties as necessary
• Travel to additional sites when needed

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or GED or equivalent
• 1 year or more of phlebotomy experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• 2 years or more of phlebotomy experience in an outpatient lab environment

Additional Job Standards:

• In lieu of work experience, a Phlebotomy certification or completed training program must come from an accredited agency
• Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
• Strong communication skills; both written and verbal
• Ability to work independently or in a team environment
• Comfortable working under minimal supervision
• Reliable transportation
• Flexibility to work overtime as needed
• Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

At LabCorp we have a passion for helping people live happy and healthy lives. Every day we provide vital information that helps our clients and patients understand their health. If you are passionate about helping people and have a drive for service, then LabCorp could be a great next career step!

Phlebotomist will work in a client office. In this role you will provide exceptional customer service, perform skilled specimen collections and be the face of the company. In addition, you will be provided opportunities for continuous growth within the organization.

Phlebotomist’s may be eligible for participation in the PST Incentive Plan, which pays a quarterly bonus based on performance metrics.

This leadership role oversees the flow of specimens, reagents, consumables, and laboratory materials across patient service centers, pre-analytical operations, histology, cytology, molecular diagnostics, and genomic testing environments, ensuring operational excellence, quality, regulatory compliance, and reliable support for precision oncology programs.

This is an exciting opportunity for a supply chain leader who understands the critical role laboratory operations play in delivering timely, accurate patient results. We welcome professionals with backgrounds in histotechnology, cytotechnology, anatomic pathology, molecular diagnostics, laboratory operations, logistics, or healthcare supply chain management who are passionate about transforming complex operational networks into scalable, efficient, and patient-focused solutions.

Work Schedule

This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned typically Monday through Friday, with occasional evening, weekend, and on-call responsibilities. This hybrid schedule includes a minimum of three in-office days per week in Burlington, NC supporting both collaboration and flexibility. Up to 50% travel, including domestic and international. Primarily office-based with occasional work in laboratory environments.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. Job Responsibilities

• Develop and execute strategic plans for Oncology and AP supply chain operations, including process standardization across patient services, pre-analytics, logistics, and laboratory supply chain functions.
• Ensure an optimized specimen supply chain from collection through result reporting by improving people, processes, systems, and financial performance.
• Influence supply chain operational strategy and financial performance while ensuring key business objectives and targets are achieved.
• Lead the development and utilization of operational analytics, forecasting models, and performance dashboards to identify risks, optimize specimen flow, and improve service levels.
• Oversee operational due diligence and integration activities for mergers and acquisitions within the AP and oncology space.
• Drive organizational effectiveness through talent development, succession planning, employee engagement, and leadership development initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with quality systems, regulatory requirements, and industry standards supporting laboratory operations.
• Partner across laboratory, operational, commercial, and executive leadership teams to drive enterprise-wide improvements and innovation.
• People leader of up to 5 direct reports

• Bachelor's degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Supply Chain, Business, Biological Sciences, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience leading laboratory, healthcare, supply chain, logistics, or related operations, including at least 2 years at the Director level with responsibility for leading leaders and cross-functional teams.
• 2+ years of experience supporting oncology, molecular diagnostics, precision medicine, anatomic pathology, or related laboratory operations.
• 2+ years of direct or indirect People Leadership experience – talent development, performance management, etc.
• Demonstrated experience driving operational excellence, process improvement, financial performance, organizational change, compliance, and quality initiatives.

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? The Role

Kyndryl is looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of Kyndryl's platform for Agentic Modernization — the platform that enables enterprises to modernize applications, processes, and operations through AI agents and agentic workflows. This role bridges customer needs, business objectives, and AI technology capabilities to deliver a secure, scalable, and enterprise-grade platform for building, deploying, governing, and operating AI agents at scale.

This is a senior, cross-functional leadership role. You will set the strategic direction for the platform, act as the primary liaison between the platform team and extended teams (solution engineering, client and account teams, partners, and delivery), and be accountable for the outcomes the platform enables across the modernization portfolio.

What You Will Do

• Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Kyndryl's Agentic Modernization platform.

• Identify platform capabilities that accelerate the transformation of legacy business processes, applications, and workflows into AI-powered agentic experiences.

• Gather and prioritize requirements from customers, developers, consultants, architects, delivery teams, and business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with AI engineers, platform teams, UX designers, cloud architects, and modernization specialists to deliver platform capabilities and enhancements.

• Own product backlogs, release planning, feature prioritization, and end-to-end lifecycle management.

• Drive platform adoption by enabling the rapid creation, deployment, orchestration, monitoring, and governance of AI agents.

• Establish and track success metrics, including modernization outcomes, platform adoption, agent deployment velocity, productivity gains, customer satisfaction, and business value realization.

• Ensure enterprise-grade security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices are embedded throughout the platform lifecycle.

• Serve as the primary liaison between the platform team and extended teams (solution engineering, client and account teams, partners, etc.), filtering and prioritizing incoming requests to the platform team.

• Mentor and provide direction to junior product management resources supporting the platform.

jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp is seeking a Quality Engineering Intern to join our Quality Assurance Team located in Baltimore, MD!

Work Schedule: Days/ Hours: 40hrs per week

Job Responsibilities:

• Quality Engineering intern will work on the projects related to maintenance and improvement of risk management files, and engineering change controls.
• Intern will review the past complaints and utilize statistical tools to analyze the historical data.
• Execute project to categorize complaints by risk levels for continuous improvement.
• Assist quality leads to identify gaps and improve the processes as identified.
• Assist supplier quality engineer to identify gaps and maintain supplier files as needed.
• Assist in Quality Assurance, CLIA Laboratory Quality or Quality Engineering projects as needed.
• Participate in Post-Market Surveillance data analysis.
• Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor.
• Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s degree program in Life Sciences or Engineering.

Additional Job Standards:

• Interest in Quality Assurance and Medical Devices.
• Eagerness to learn US, EU medical device regulations and QMS standards.
• Interested in learning quality engineering tools and apply classroom knowledge in a fast-paced and growing industry setting.
• Show initiative and the ability to work independently under general supervision.
• Maintains professionalism, including punctuality and appropriate conduct.
• Strong communication skills; both written and verbal.
• Able to use persuasive, logical arguments based on data.
• Actively participates in training sessions and applies newly learned skills accordingly.
• Assist people in finding creative solutions which comply with standards and regulation or other constraints.
• Ability to collaborate with various stakeholders and colleagues in a professional setting.
• Proficient on basic computer programs such as Microsoft Office tools

The PGDx Quality Assurance Team ensures the suitability, safety and effectiveness of next generation sequencing (NGS) medical devices that are developed, manufactured and distributed from our Baltimore, MD site. This position will work with Development, Operations, Manufacturing, and other Quality functional areas to ensure work is completed in accordance with PGDx procedures.

• Connection to Labcorp’s inclusive culture through engagement with our employee resource groups (ERGs)and values-driven community initiatives
• Dedicated mentoring connections to guide your growth, provide career advice, and support your internship journey

jobs.title: Fillmore New Orleans - F&B Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

Live Nation’s Concerts Division is where tours are born, artists come to life, and fans get to experience the rush of live music. From our dozens of owned/operated Amphitheaters to our Global Touring team, from Ticketing and Venue Operations to Marketing and Sales... we foster a fun and upbeat work culture with no shortage of opportunities. With perks ranging from free concert tickets to dog-friendly offices, to progressive benefits like student loan reimbursement and adoption/fertility support... it’s no wonder we are certified as a Great Place to Work organization and one of People Magazine’s “50 Companies that Care”. We want everyone to feel like they belong and can thrive in our community, so we strive to help you achieve your career and personal goals. Live music is our passion and where we find our common ground. There has never been a better time to join Live Nation.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

• Ensure that standards are being met regarding staff uniforms, quality of service/food, timeliness of food, guest relations
• Ensure comfortable atmosphere in room (lighting, temperature, music volume, cleanliness-line of sight)
• Assist and support staff in any of their job functions as needed
• Conduct daily pre-shift in an upbeat and motivational manner
• Conduct informative and motivational pre-shifts
• Direct interaction with trainers and trainees
• Conduct 100% table visits
• Ensure that service is up to HOBE standards
• Assist in perceiving and troubleshooting potential problems
• Assist in scheduling staff, voids/closing comps, liquor pulls, cutting staffing levels, checking out all servers and bar staff at end of shift
• Maintain HOBE safety and sanitation standards and hold staff accountable for doing the same
• Support and communicate with all other departments
• Enter all liquor orders and manage inventory process for the bars
• Monitor the labor cost of the shift, paying close attention to overtime
• Work directly with the special events department on executing and preparing for all special event orders to ensure proper staffing levels, food and beverage requirements are met, and that all aspects of the event are carried out to the client’s approval
• Accurate accounting close-out of special events
• Checking accuracy of labor system at the end of the shift
• Oversee parties/special events in the rooms
• Provide guidance in executing outstanding guest service while following the House of Blues Entertainment implemented Steps of Service
• Conducts performance counseling and ensures discipline procedures follow all HOBE guidelines
• Recruitment and Training of hourly staff members
• Develop strategies to generate/enhance revenue

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Required:

• TIPS and RAMP/ Responsible Alcohol Awareness Training Certification or Equivalent
• Ability to work late hours
• 3 years supervisory experience in high volume restaurant/live entertainment environment
• Working knowledge of restaurant and bar operations
• Entry level knowledge of state, federal and local liquor laws, retail operations, computers (Microsoft Office- Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint)
• Skill in leadership, guest relations, decision making and staff schedule maintenance
• Ability to engage in positive interaction with staff and guests, prioritize, organize, motivate staff, problem solve, delegate, follow-up, communicate, diffuse possibly volatile situations with tact
• High School diploma

Preferred:

• Point of Sales knowledge, preferably Square
• Some college or college degree

Physical Demands/Working Environment:

• Working environment is fast-paced, loud and stressful
• Position requires extended periods of prolonged standing and working on your feet
• Must be able to lift or move up to 35 lbs using proper lifting techniques

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion.  You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work.  We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife.  As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process.  Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

**Please note that the compensation information provided is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and Equal Pay Transparency Rules. It is estimated based on what a successful Colorado applicant might be paid. It assumes that the successful candidate will be in Colorado or perform the position from Colorado. Similar positions located outside of

Colorado will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Live Nation takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, as well as the position’s work location, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the CO EPEWA, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Gum & Mint category is a key growth priority for Mars, contributing significantly to its global snacking portfolio. With a leading market share (>50%), Mars’ iconic brands like Extra, Orbit, and Doublemint drive multi-billion dollar revenues across 180+ countries. This category supports Mars’ growth and profitability through innovation, convenience, and broad consumer appeal.

As part of the Global Gum & Mint Portfolio team, this role will lead the Gum Brand Marketing portfolio agenda, designing its marketing strategy, brand positioning, lead advertising brief and develop/lead the agenda for the global Gum community. It is main focus is on the development of the global brand Orbit/Extra (OEFY) brand agenda while being involved on Airwaves, Extra USA and Hubba Bubba brand teams. This role reports to the Global Gum & Mint Portfolio Leader.

What are we looking for?

• 7+ years of relevant experience required
• Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred
• Strong Marketing expertise in brand positioning, brand building, architecture, and communication.
• Proven record of strategic brand planning and development as well as communication brief and development.
• Strong expertise in consumer growth agenda and portfolio strategy.
• Strategic mindset with strong execution capability
• Strong team leadership and ability to drive influence across matrix organization and stakeholder management

What will be your key responsibilities?

• Develop and drive Orbit/Extra - OEFY brand globally. Lead the global brand governance and ensure alignment on co-create, ambition, positioning and portfolio architecture.
• Drive the brand positioning and its main strategic pillars of development with strong consumer insight/data driven decisions
• In partnership with the Brand & Content team, build meaningful distinction and relevance for OEFY Brand with Gen Z and Gen Alpha to accelerate category growth by: identifying key drivers from data driven and human cultural insights, redefining and strengthening audiences and positioning, building communication and advertising briefs, and dialing up authenticity by tapping into content/activation ideas/partnerships that ladder up to new/community led/culturally relevant ways of building brands (in process accelerate earned, shared, owned aspect of deployment)
• Define brand and portfolio architecture by analyzing brand health, understanding roles, brand stages/evolution across markets, customer segments, innovation play and 2030 category growth strategy
• Lead co-create and collaboration across key markets by orchestrating and driving engagement through period connects, key forums etc.
• Maintain oversight of global brand strategy in partnership with brand and content teams, regions and global brand governance, and on-going connectivity across brand strategic initiatives
• Build and develop the Gum community through the leadership of knowledge by aiming to inspire and guide the global community towards our brands growth agenda.

What can you expect from Mars?

• Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
• Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
• A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
• An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
